visualCharacteristics.summary: Find Branches & ATMs search: state and city selects, a collapsible service-type checklist, Reset/Search buttons, links under the form, and client-side results from authored rows or a same-origin JSON sheet.

contentPattern.structure: Optional heading; key rows [State | All], [City | All], [Looking for | text], [Services | list], [Search | text], [Reset | text], [No results | text], [Data | link to .json]; location rows [name | type | state | city | address | services | phone/link]; a links-only row shown under the form.

usage: Find Branches & ATMs search: state and city selects, a collapsible service-type checklist, Reset/Search buttons, links under the form, and client-side results from authored rows or a same-origin JSON sheet.

suitableFor: branch / ATM / store locators with state-city filters
